title: Customer activation milestone lifecycle
content:
Purpose:
This working tracker captures the end-to-end activation lifecycle for inference rollouts (hosted, dedicated, private). It's designed to be a lightweight, operational artifact the CSM and Solutions Engineer update weekly prior to QBRs and renewal conversations.

Scope and how to use:
- Scope: New production inference rollouts and major expansion phases (model swaps, scaling to dedicated). Not for incremental prompt tuning iterations.
- Owner: CSM maintains the sheet; Solutions/SEs update technical fields.
- Cadence: Updated weekly (Mon), reviewed in standup and included in the QBR packet.
- Color-key: 
  - GREEN = on-track, no unresolved blockers
  - YELLOW = risk present, mitigation planned
  - RED = blocker impacting go-live/SLAs

Quick summary for stakeholders:
- One-line status: Customer X currently in canary stage for image2text model; throughput optimization outstanding (YELLOW). Renewal target: 2025-01 (70% probability if perf improvements complete).

Milestone ledger (single-line rows for quick scan):
- Milestone: Commercial kickoff / Contract signed | Owner: Aisha Kapoor | Target: 2024-09-01 | Status: GREEN | Blockers: none | Next action: invoice + billing setup | Linked: JIRA-REDW-4110
- Milestone: Technical kickoff & network prep | Owner: Diego Alvarez | Target: 2024-09-07 | Status: GREEN | Blockers: VPC peering window | Next action: net team scheduled change | Linked: CONFLUENCE-SEGMENT-PEER
- Milestone: Test deploy (staging) | Owner: Priya Singh | Target: 2024-10-02 | Status: YELLOW | Blockers: intermittent OOMs at 2k seq | Mitigation: apply dynamic batching/kv cache; SEs to patch runtime 2024-10-09 | Linked: JIRA-REDW-4352
- Milestone: Canary (10% traffic) | Owner: Aisha Kapoor | Target: 2024-11-15 | Status: YELLOW | Blockers: throughput below SLA at peak | Mitigation: tune batching + enable warm pools; infra request submitted | Next action: infra team smoke test 2024-11-20 | Linked: JIRA-REDW-4491
- Milestone: Full roll (100% traffic) | Owner: Diego Alvarez | Target: 2024-12-10 | Status: RED | Blockers: autoscaler fails under burst patterns | Mitigation: fallback policy to smaller model variant; SRE engagement required | Next action: SRE run chaos test 2024-11-28 | Linked: JIRA-REDW-4597
- Milestone: Post-roll adoption check (30/60/90d) | Owner: Aisha Kapoor | Target: 2025-01-10 | Status: PENDING | Blockers: none yet | Next action: schedule adoption survey

Blocker register (active items):
- Blocker ID: BR-001 | Summary: Autoscaler crash on sudden 5x burst | Impact: prevents full roll, customer SLAs at risk | Reported: 2024-11-24 | Owner: SRE (Diego Alvarez) | Status: investigating | Notes: reproduces with synthetic load; probable race in scale-down path; mitigation: enable conservative cooldown + patch rollout
- Blocker ID: BR-002 | Summary: Customer security review delay (KMS integration audit) | Impact: delays private deployment for regulated env | Reported: 2024-10-30 | Owner: Security PM (Priya Singh) | Status: awaiting 3rd party attestation | Notes: legal loop opened; recommend interim HSM audit request

Risk scoring and renewal signal (short):
- Combined health: 0.7 (0-1 scale; 1 best). Drivers: performance risk (0.5), commercial satisfaction (0.9), security compliance (0.6).
- Renewal signal: conditional; full renewal likely only if autoscaler and throughput issues resolved before end of canary.

Playbook snippets (what to do when a milestone slips to YELLOW/RED):
1) Immediate triage (within 24h): Gather triage notes, link failing logs, assign SRE+SE owners, update blocker register.
2) Customer comms: CSM sends daily status email to customer champion, include mitigation ETA and rollback plan.
3) Internal escalation (48h): If no mitigation in 48h, engage Eng leadership and Solutions triage call.
4) Soft-fallback: If production SLA at risk, enable model variant fallback and rate-limit non-critical paths.
5) Post-mortem: Add remediation items to next sprint and to QBR issues list.

Operational templates (copy/paste snippets):
- Weekly update email subject: "[Customer] Activation status — week of YYYY-MM-DD — Action required: <yes/no>"
- Daily blocker update snippet: "BR-XXX: <one-line summary> | Owner: <name> | ETA: <date> | Next action: <one-line>"

Notes and open questions:
- Confirm which infra region will be used for the full roll (us-west-2 vs eu-west-1) — affects latency SLOs and routing policies.
- Need explicit SLA acceptance from customer for warm pool cost (they prefer spot-backed capacity).
- Evaluate whether model quantization will be acceptable for 10% of requests to reduce cost; legal/quality sign-off needed.

Appendix: Useful links and artifacts (drop here for quick access):
- Confluence activation playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/activation-playbook
- Canary test harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/canary-harness
- Relevant JIRA: JIRA-REDW-4352, JIRA-REDW-4491, JIRA-REDW-4597

Document history (changelog):
- 2024-10-18: created by Aisha Kapoor (initial scoping and milestone list)
- 2024-11-05: updated mitigation plan for staging OOMs (Priya Singh)
- 2024-11-24: added autoscaler blocker and emergency playbook (Diego Alvarez)
- 2024-12-05: reviewed for QBR inclusion (Aisha Kapoor)

End of tracker.
